title: Elite: The Pylon Choir Falls Silent
description: Elite remix of The Pylon Choir Falls Silent: the same story pressure becomes a sharper tactical problem, not a stat-inflated repeat.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and battle line answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: floodplain mirrors, collapsing bridges, and corrupted river channels

objectives.primary: Hold two sun markers at the end of the same round. Elite remix: complete it while stabilizing a secondary solar seal.
optional: Stop every reinforcement trigger or defeat the reinforcement commander first

enemyWaves.entry: split flanks with one enemy already contesting an objective

boss.mechanic: changes start positions, suppresses one recovery lane, and forces objective timing

specialRules: Mirror Orders: enemies copy the last objective interaction unless interrupted.
Anchor Corruption: structures worsen hazards every two turns.
Elite Remix: enemy AI prioritizes objectives and exposed support Titans.
Restricted Recovery: healing or recovery tiles deactivate after use.
victoryConditions: Hold two sun markers at the end of the same round.
Secondary solar seal stabilized before extraction

firstClear: Elite Aten Ra mission 11 codex shard

stars.three: Primary, secondary, and all optional objectives completed

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan Titan; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
